Mehsana Urban Institute of Sciences (MUIS)

Basic & Applied Science Programs

Develop scientific analysis skills with UGC approved B.Sc and M.Sc programs. Gain hands-on laboratory expertise in organic chemistry, microbiology, and biotechnology.

Allotted Courses Directory

UG Degree 3 Years

Bachelor of Science (B.Sc)

  • Core Specializations: Chemistry, Microbiology, Biotechnology, Physics, Mathematics.
  • Focus areas: Qualitative analyses, micro-organism cultures, and mathematical modeling.
  • Combines theoretical lectures with detailed daily laboratory sessions.
Careers: Laboratory Assistant, Chemical Inspector, Quality Control Executive.
PG Degree 2 Years

Master of Science (M.Sc)

  • Advanced disciplines: Organic Chemistry, Analytical Chemistry, Biotechnology, Microbiology.
  • Involves comprehensive thesis projects and analytical laboratory tests.
Careers: R&D Lab Specialist, Junior Research Fellow, Quality Assurance Specialist.
